items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: They truly are an extension of each other, aren’t they? Ellington and Strayhorn?

ctx.x: Sometimes. But I have to sit and listen. I have to really listen.
They truly are an extension of each other, aren’t they? Ellington and Strayhorn?
That’s such a happy, happy, happy union.
